# Roadstar's Garage - Detailing Studio & Vehicle Care

> Top-rated automotive detailing studio and multi-bay car wash located in Ganpathi Nagar, Konia, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Specializing in 9H nano-ceramic coating, paint protection, calibrated high-pressure foam treatments, interior sanitization, and superbike detailing.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **9H Ceramic Coating & Paint Protection**: Multi-layer quartz application with hydrophobic resistance, swirl defense, and mirror finish.
- **High-Pressure Snow Foam Wash**: pH-neutral active foam bath, touch-safe microfiber mitts, high-pressure grit rinse.
- **Interior Cabin Vacuuming & Deep Sanitization**: High-suction upholstery extraction, AC duct antimicrobial sanitization, steam detailing.
- **Underbody Chassis Ramp Wash**: Hydraulic ramp lift with calibrated chassis jet blasters to purge mud, salt, and road grit.
- **Superbike Detailing**: Dedicated paddock stand bay, chain degreasing & lubrication, swingarm cleanup, spoke & alloy detailing.
- **Touchless Studio Washing**: High-velocity filtered rinse and streak-free vehicle blow-dry.
